archetypes.name: dyn-closure-parser
archetypes.rationale: The scanner uses heuristics to distinguish always-loaded reads from conditional SKILL.md references.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new skill closure scanner against real /design and /implement directive shapes. Focus on over-counting citations, under-counting supported mandatory reads, conditional table and bullet exclusions, and failure-only macro suppression. Check that missing markdown references fail closed without rejecting legitimate non-markdown mandatory reads. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-lint-wiring
archetypes.rationale: The change adds CLI, Makefile, pre-commit, docs, and baseline integration surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new CLI registry rows, Make targets, pre-commit hook, and docs for consistency with existing lint surfaces. Pay special attention to whether the pytest target should remain standalone under the current test-harness shard invariant and whether the growth lint runs in the intended local and pre-commit paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
